#!/bin/bash
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
mkdir data mkdir completed mkdir hierarchies mkdir processing mkdir mappings mkdir resources mkdir reports mkdir beforeConversion mkdir logs
find data/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find data/ -type d -exec rm -rf {} \; find processing/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find completed/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find mappings/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find resources/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find reports/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \;
rm -rf pic-sure-hpds/
#aws s3 cp ${managed_inputs} data/
aws s3 cp ${metadata_file} data/metadata.json
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
stdy_id="phs004023" abv_name="Imaging_COPDGene"
echo "Processing ${stdy_id} ${abv_name}"
find data/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find data/ -type d -exec rm -rf {} \; find processing/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find completed/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find mappings/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find resources/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find reports/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find beforeConversion/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \;
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/decoded_data/ beforeConversion/ --recursive --no-progress aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/mappings/${stdy_id}/mapping2.csv data/mapping2.csv --no-progress aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/data/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv data/ --no-progress
### All done with the role before processing. unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
### need to handle iso-8859 encodings for file in beforeConversion/*; do echo "$file" FILE_ENCODING=$(file -i $file) iconv -f 8859_1 -t UTF-8//TRANSLIT "$file" -o data/$(basename $file) done rm -rf resources/job.config
echo "trialid=${abv_name^^}" > resources/job.config echo "mappingfile=data/mapping2.csv" >> resources/job.config echo "patientmappingfile=data/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" >> resources/job.config echo "usepatientmapping=Y" >> resources/job.config echo "skipdataheader=Y" >> resources/job.config echo "skipheaders=Y" >> resources/job.config
echo "Numeric mappings before Analyzer $(grep "NUMERIC" data/mapping2.csv | wc -l)" echo "Text mappings before Analyzer $(grep "TEXT" data/mapping2.csv | wc -l)" java -jar jars/DataAnalyzer.jar -propertiesfile resources/job.config -mappingskipheaders N -trialid ${abv_name^^} 2>logs/${stdy_id}_analyzer_logs.txt
# Upload logs aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
#TODO remove aws credientals. We have matured past this in multiple places. export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
#aws s3 cp ./logs/removed_mappings.csv s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/logs/${stdy_id}_removed_mappings.csv --no-progress
### All done with the role before data processing. unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
cp completed/mapping.csv data/mapping2.csv
echo "Numeric mappings after Analyzer $(grep "NUMERIC" data/mapping2.csv | wc -l)" echo "Text mappings after Analyzer $(grep "TEXT" data/mapping2.csv | wc -l)"
java -jar jars/Partitioner.jar -partitiononsize 50 -propertiesfile resources/job.config -mappingskipheaders N -trialid ${abv_name^^} 2>logs/${stdy_id}_partition_logs.txt if [ -s logs/${stdy_id}_partition_logs.txt ]; then cat logs/${stdy_id}_partition_logs.txt echo "Errors in ${stdy_id} partitioner" exit 255 fi bash runpartition.sh -j 15 -c 'config.part*.config' -r resources/
java -jar jars/MergePartitions.jar -propertiesfile resources/job.config 2>logs/${stdy_id}_merge_logs.txt if [ -s logs/${stdy_id}_merge_logs.txt ]; then cat logs/${stdy_id}_merge_logs.txt echo "Errors in ${stdy_id} merge" exit 255 fi if ! [ -s completed/${abv_name^^}_allConcepts.csv ]; then echo "ALLCONCEPTS for ${abv_name} is empty!" >> review_log.txt # exit 255 fi
# assume role to handle larger data sets unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
#aws s3 cp data/mapping2.csv s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/mappings/${stdy_id}/mapping2_post_analyzer.csv --no-progress #aws s3 cp completed/${abv_name^^}_allConcepts.csv s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/completed/${stdy_id}/${stdy_id,,}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv --no-progress
#find data/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \;
### remove role for next iteration unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
